name: dwt2
comment: Sig [cA,cH,cV,cD]=dwt2(X,'haar'): single-level 2-D Haar DWT, 4x4 ramp -> 2x2 subbands. Approximation cA=[7 11; 23 27] (col-major: cA(1,1)=7, cA(2,2)=27); horizontal cH(1,1)=-1; vertical cV(1,1)=-4; diagonal cD(1,1)=0 (separable ramp has no diagonal detail); sum(cA)=68. Pins distinct cA entries (not a constant) so the orientation/scaling of all four subbands is fixed.
